title: Two Sentry envelope tests can miss a new item type or a captured event
evidence: chat-edits-sentry-envelope.test.ts blanks clock and id fields in event items only; a session, client_report or transaction item would carry an unblanked time (fix: assert every item is an event). app/routes/api.chat-run-roadmap.test.ts:122 searches envelopes that are empty today and strips ids but not timestamps; if it ever captures an event, reuse the path-scoped blanking. From the PR 1381 review (2026-11-12).
